answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 23 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the hollow solution is checked at the ledge gate and logged, the zephyr audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence forfeits the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. That is 37 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
